document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
In the arid wastes you come across a trail! Make a Luck roll: If 
failed, you see a caravan in the distance, but it is moving away 
from you! In your weakened condition you can’t hope to catch 
it up. You collapse beside the trail, weeping. Drink another day’s 
supply of water, and go to 235.
